title: The de-excitation photon: what the excited state chi2 must do after scattering in LZ, and what a single-site event already implies
question: After an inelastic up-scatter at the LZ vertex, for which chi2 -> chi1 gamma lifetimes would the delta-photon have converted in the TPC (two-site), been tagged by the Skin/OD (prompt/delayed veto) or escaped; what lower limit on tau does the clean single-site science-sample event give; how does it map onto transition moments and the corpus models; what would a population show?
headline_result: The clean un-vetoed single-site event implies tau(chi2 -> chi1 gamma) > 0.43 us (90% CL); LZ's sensitive time is 1.68 us per event (61% second TPC site, 38% OD delayed veto, 1.7% RFR S1-only, 0% prompt veto, since chi2 cannot reach the Skin within 0.25 us); with P023's LZ-rate moments, photon-M1 inelastic models have P(clean) = 0.9/0.5/0.1 at delta = 321/344/358 keV, excluding the 358-385 keV window at >= 90% CL; Higgsino (tau_gamma ~ 0.06 s), dark photon (1e18 s) and L10-type loop (~300 s) all escape
key_numbers: v2 = 663 km/s (630-746), speed loss 9.6%, wind altitude +0.5 deg; TPC chord 65 cm / 0.98 us (0.44-1.74), Skin 0.11 us, GdLS 0.99 us, out after 3 us; lambda_LXe 2.30 cm (300 keV); P_notclean = 1.68 us/tau; shares TPC 60.7 (merged 8.5), delayed 37.7, RFR 1.7, prompt 0%; P_clean 0.008/0.10/0.37/0.90/0.975 at 0.14/0.43/1.4/15.7/66 us; tau90 0.43 us (variants 0.41-0.49), P_clean=0.9 at 15.7 us (P023 12.7); BR_gamma <= 0.9 prompt; mu_tr < 2.6e-3 (300) - 1.6e-3 mu_N (380 keV); photon-M1 ceilings N=1 321/344/358, N=3.65 302/330/348, N=0.105 346/362/370 keV; Higgsino P_notclean 2.8e-5; L10 loop tau 280 s - 1e7 s; population 66 us: 97.5% clean, 1.5% two-site, 0.92% delayed; 1.4 us: 32/46/22%; companions 297 keV ER at 42 cm (7-88), dt_S1 0.63 us, sep/dt = 700 km/s; delayed-veto content 0.009-0.70 per clean event
model_or_mechanism: chi2 decay in flight; lab-frame kinematics with Baxter SHM boosted on 16 June 2023 and projected onto SURF vertical (astropy ephemeris + GMST); Woodcock-tracking photon MC (photoabsorption + Klein-Nishina) in a cylindrical LZ model (TPC, RFR 13.75 cm, PTFE, Skin, Ti vessels, 61 cm GdLS, water) with the paper's veto windows/thresholds; single-event likelihood P_clean(tau); Gamma = mu^2 delta^3/pi with P023 mu_tr(delta)

confidence: medium - transit-time physics robust (<= 15% under all variants) but geometry beyond the TPC and veto light yields are recalled
